title: BillingRule
description: One version of a billing-cycle rule (bank-rules-spec §2/§3, engine BillingRule). The statement day is clamped to the month end; a posting ON the statement day belongs to that statement only if statement_day_inclusive. holiday_rollover 'next_business_day' and due.day_kind 'business' need a verified business-day calendar, which protocol v1 does not carry: the engine reports such a rule as BILLING_RULE_INVALID (NEEDS_DATA).

effective_from.description: First posting date the version applies to (absent = unbounded).

effective_to.description: Exclusive end of validity (absent = unbounded). The rule must cover the transaction's posting window; in the date-shift search a card whose version has ended is unavailable on that date (engine-spec §12.9).

source.description: Where the rule comes from (S-nn, user declaration, fixture). Absent = empty.

FixedDayDue.description: Due on a fixed day (clamped to the month end) of the statement month plus month_offset; must fall after the statement date.

DaysAfterStatementDue.description: Due N calendar or business days after the statement date.
